name: DearMe
description: Your private AI growth team. 12 specialist roles (Chief of Staff, Content Producer, Opportunity Hunter, Brand Site Builder, Ads Manager, Research, Audience Care, Data Analyst, Health Monitor, Reporting, Chat, Browser) that turn one person's work, voice, proof, and relationships into shipped content, real opportunities, a live personal site, and a daily Dear-me letter.

apiBaseUrl.label: DearMe service URL
apiBaseUrl.help: Service URL for private team work, voice checks, opportunity drafts, and brand site updates. Defaults to https://api.dearme.app for production.

apiKey.label: DearMe team access
apiKey.help: Provisioned during onboarding for the private growth team.

handle.label: DearMe handle
handle.help: Your dearme.app handle (e.g. peterc). The brand site lives at dearme.app/<handle>.

defaults.dailyLetterChannel.label: Where to deliver the daily Dear-me letter
defaults.dailyLetterChannel.help: Pick the private delivery channel that should receive your morning Dear-me letter (iMessage / Telegram / WhatsApp / Slack / etc).

defaults.voiceGate.minScore.label: Minimum voice-gate score
defaults.voiceGate.minScore.help: Drafts scored below this threshold are revised before reaching you. 92 is a strong default; lower for more output, higher for tighter voice.

defaults.budget.dailyUsdCap.label: Daily AI spend cap
defaults.budget.dailyUsdCap.help: Hard cap on combined private work + ads daily spend. Hits will pause autonomous work until you approve.

openclaw.lineage: DearMe runtime corpus (verbatim ports + typed registry). Source of truth: packages/plugins/dearme-agent-prompts/src/registry.ts.
